notes: New aircraft (beta): FlyByWire A32NX, FlyByWire A380X, Headwind A330-900neo and TFDi MD-11.
Cockpit profiles are saved per airframe, and can be copied between airframes or shared by the whole type.
The changelog lists, aircraft by aircraft, what can and cannot be failed in the aircraft itself.
The window opens where you left it.
The Fenix EFB button now uses port 8183; press Fix in Settings if your Fenix tablet was patched before.
